Man City Players Concerned Over Club's Verdict, Tuchel Comments

Manchester City players are reportedly worried about their future following a guilty verdict against the club, according to Thomas Tuchel. The context of this concern is linked to potential UEFA punishments, with England vs. Croatia matches being watched by 6,000 schoolchildren due to prior UEFA sanctions. Thomas Tuchel's stance on selecting Manchester City stars for England, particularly if the club faces relegation, is also a point of discussion.
